hook_text: I'm Bra Sipho, the Taxi Rank Economist. Petrol goes up - watch what happens to your taxi fare. That's economics.
clip_script: You know that feeling when you go to the rank, you've got your usual R20 coin ready for your trip to town. You step up to the sliding door, and the queue marshal says, 'Chief, it's R22 now.' You check your pockets. The coin hasn't changed. It's still a Mandela R5 and maybe some silver. But suddenly, your money is too small. That trip you took yesterday? Today it costs more. That, my friend, is what we call INFLATION.
